## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement.

## Motivation
Why is this needed? What problem does it solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the approach. Include any UI mockups, API shapes, or data flow diagrams if helpful.

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches were considered and why were they rejected?

## Scope
- [ ] Backend / engine
- [ ] Frontend / UI
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## Out of Scope
What is explicitly NOT included in this feature?
